title: comparison of the ideal strict transform with its extended ideal under a flat morphism
statement: Let f:X→S be a flat morphism of schemes [def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let I be a quasi-coherent ideal on S whose associated ideal module is of finite type, and let K be a quasi-coherent ideal on X [pqf-def-coherent]. Write p:X×_S Bl_I(S)→X for the first projection [def-pc-fibre-product, def-nagata-global-blowup]. The module strict transform of K along the retained centre I [def-trf-module-strict-transform] is isomorphic to the module associated to the extended ideal K.comap p [def-nagata-extended-ideal]. This asserts no arbitrary choice of a new ideal and needs neither a preserved open nor finite presentation of K.

source.place: Tag 080D (1), definition-strict-transform; Tag 080F, lemma-strict-transform-flat, exceptional-power-torsion argument; Modules Tag 01AJ for the ideal image

proof.text: Put Y=X×_S Bl_I(S), with projections p and g. The exceptional ideal E=I O_{Bl_I(S)} is Cartier by principalization. Since g is flat by base change, the structure module of Y is flat over Bl_I(S). Apply the Cartier-support injectivity lemma to it: restriction to the complement W of g^{-1}|E| is injective on sections of every open.

Let alpha:p* K→O_Y be the pullback inclusion composed with the structure-module comparison. The ideal-tensor comparison identifies its image with (K.comap p).toModules. Off the exceptional divisor p is an isomorphism, so alpha restricts to an injection there. Hence ker alpha is contained in the subsheaf of p*K supported on Y minus W.

Conversely a section of p*K vanishing on W has alpha-image vanishing on W; sectionwise injectivity for O_Y makes the image zero. Thus ker alpha is exactly the kernel of the restriction unit. Quotienting by this kernel and applying the first isomorphism theorem identifies the strict transform with image alpha and therefore the extended ideal.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_moduleStrictTransform_ideal_iso_comap
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f]
    (I : S.IdealSheafData) [I.toModules.IsFiniteType]
    (K : X.IdealSheafData) [K.toModules.IsQuasicoherent] :
    Nonempty (moduleStrictTransform f I K.toModules ≅
      (K.comap (pullback.fst f I.blowupMap)).toModules)
